biological_unit: mouse; 15 RPPA measurements are not 15 animals
aggregation: median of available technical measurements; at least 8 of 15 required per mouse/protein
primary_method: two-sided Welch t on mouse summaries, original supplied expression scale
family: all 77 proteins times both contrasts = 154 planned tests; unavailable tests assigned p=1 only for adjustment
correction: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR; Benjamini-Yekutieli sensitivity for arbitrary dependence
sensitivity: mean instead of median aggregation, same family and BH adjustment; not an independent replication
pca: descriptive only; retain proteins observed in all 72 mouse summaries; z-score each protein; no imputation
exclusions: no mice removed; insufficient mouse/protein cells remain missing
limitations: Exploratory reanalysis, not reproduction of the source SOM or three-level mixed model
Unknown litter/batch structure is not adjusted; between-mouse independence remains an assumption
No causal rescue, behavioral improvement or clinical efficacy claim
Small groups, missingness and dilution aggregation can influence results
BH control requires independence or suitable positive dependence; BY is also reported
